# Nabbit

Nabbit is a Windows-first Tauri tray utility combining searchable local clipboard history with explicit-click yt-dlp/ffmpeg downloads.

Website: https://tanzir71.github.io/nabbit/
Simulation: https://tanzir71.github.io/nabbit/demo/
Repository: https://github.com/tanzir71/nabbit
Privacy: https://github.com/tanzir71/nabbit/blob/main/PRIVACY.md

The public demo is deterministic HTML. It does not read the clipboard, contact YouTube, launch sidecars, or write files.

## v2 development

Nabbit v2 is being built in public. Follow milestones M0–M12 at https://tanzir71.github.io/nabbit/#progress. There is no v2 release yet; the first release follows M12. The current demo shows the accepted v0.1 tray app.

## Build

npm install
npm run verify
cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings

On Windows, fetch yt-dlp with scripts/fetch-binaries.ps1 and supply ffmpeg in src-tauri/binaries or on PATH. Run npm run tauri:dev.

## Privacy and behavior

- Clipboard history stays in local SQLite under OS app data.
- Supported links are staged only; downloads never start from clipboard observation.
- A user chooses format/range and clicks Download before yt-dlp/ffmpeg run.
- No analytics or cloud clipboard sync are included.
- Retention options are 30, 60, or 90 days; pinned entries survive cleanup.
- Password-manager exclusions and optional sensitive-text heuristics reduce accidental storage.

Nabbit is a working codename and is not release-clear. Use download features only for content you have rights to obtain and follow each site's terms.
